mapper.update: INSERT INTO company (corporate_number, name, kana, name_en, postal_code, location, process, aggregated_year, status, close_date, close_cause, kind, representative_name, capital_stock, employee_number, company_size_male, company_size_female, business_summary, company_url, founding_year, date_of_establishment, qualification_grade) VALUES (#{corporateNumber}, #{name}, #{kana}, #{nameEn}, #{postalCode}, #{location}, #{process}, #{aggregatedYear}, #{status}, #{closeDate}::date, #{closeCause}, #{kind}, #{representativeName}, #{capitalStock}, #{employeeNumber}, #{companySizeMale}, #{companySizeFemale}, #{businessSummary}, #{companyUrl}, #{foundingYear}, #{dateOfEstablishment}::date, #{qualificationGrade}) ON CONFLICT (corporate_number) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, kana = EXCLUDED.kana, name_en = EXCLUDED.name_en, postal_code = EXCLUDED.postal_code, location = EXCLUDED.location, process = EXCLUDED.process, aggregated_year = EXCLUDED.aggregated_year, status = EXCLUDED.status, close_date = EXCLUDED.close_date, close_cause = EXCLUDED.close_cause, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, representative_name = EXCLUDED.representative_name, capital_stock = EXCLUDED.capital_stock, employee_number = EXCLUDED.employee_number, company_size_male = EXCLUDED.company_size_male, company_size_female = EXCLUDED.company_size_female, business_summary = EXCLUDED.business_summary, company_url = EXCLUDED.company_url, founding_year = EXCLUDED.founding_year, date_of_establishment = EXCLUDED.date_of_establishment, qualification_grade = EXCLUDED.qualification_grade, updated_at = now() WHERE ( company.name, company.kana, company.name_en, company.postal_code, company.location, company.process, company.aggregated_year, company.status, company.close_date, company.close_cause, company.kind, company.representative_name, company.capital_stock, company.employee_number, company.company_size_male, company.company_size_female, company.business_summary, company.company_url, company.founding_year, company.date_of_establishment, company.qualification_grade ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.name, EXCLUDED.kana, EXCLUDED.name_en, EXCLUDED.postal_code, EXCLUDED.location, EXCLUDED.process, EXCLUDED.aggregated_year, EXCLUDED.status, EXCLUDED.close_date, EXCLUDED.close_cause, EXCLUDED.kind, EXCLUDED.representative_name, EXCLUDED.capital_stock, EXCLUDED.employee_number, EXCLUDED.company_size_male, EXCLUDED.company_size_female, EXCLUDED.business_summary, EXCLUDED.company_url, EXCLUDED.founding_year, EXCLUDED.date_of_establishment, EXCLUDED.qualification_grade)
